data.narrative:
Freeform is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $125M+ to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comparable universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company operating in the same sector. Primary peers include Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Generalist AI, Divergent, and Exotec, establishing a benchmark set of companies at similar development stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($125M) as a proxy for post-money valuation, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B progression, yielding $238M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables (Generalist AI at $2.0B, Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B, and Dexterity at $1.6B) produces a median valuation of $1.8B, with an observed range of $1.6B to $2.0B. The stage-progression method suggests earlier-stage positioning, while peer median reflects current market pricing for robotics Series B companies.

Triangulation of both methods produces a valuation range of $202M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $994M. The wide range reflects material uncertainty regarding whether Freeform's competitive positioning and technical achievement align closer to stage-based growth projections or peer benchmarks. Key uncertainties include revenue traction relative to peers and the degree of commercialization risk embedded in comparable valuations.
